Monsanto Co New (MON) Holder Polygon Management LTD Lowered Its Stake by $29.75 Million; As Vodafone Group Plc New (VOD) Share Value Rose, Shareholder Merriman Wealth Management Has Lowered by $620,900 Its Stake 
January 16, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Merriman Wealth Management Llc decreased its stake in Vodafone Group Plc New (VOD) by 11.37% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Merriman Wealth Management Llc sold 22,175 shares as the company’s stock rose 16.21% with the market. The institutional investor held 172,807 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $4.92 million, down from 194,982 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Merriman Wealth Management Llc who had been investing in Vodafone Group Plc New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $81.29 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.56% or $0.49 during the last trading session, reaching $31.93. About 2.90M shares traded. Vodafone Group Plc (NASDAQ:VOD) has declined 13.23% since January 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 29.93% the S&P500. 
Polygon Management Ltd decreased its stake in Monsanto Co New (MON) by 71.43% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Polygon Management Ltd sold 250,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.51% with the market. The institutional investor held 100,000 shares of the agricultural chemicals company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $11.98 million, down from 350,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Polygon Management Ltd who had been investing in Monsanto Co New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $52.76 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.13% or $0.16 during the last trading session, reaching $119.7. About 2.20M shares traded. Monsanto Company (NYSE:MON) has risen 15.46% since January 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.24% the S&P500. 
Among 8 analysts covering Vodafone Group PLC (ADR) ( NASDAQ:VOD ), 4 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 50% are positive. Vodafone Group PLC (ADR) had 13 analyst reports since October 19, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Buy” rating by Bank of America given on Wednesday, April 20. The stock has “Buy” rating by Goldman Sachs on Tuesday, January 10. Bank of America upgraded Vodafone Group Plc (NASDAQ:VOD) on Wednesday, August 9 to “Buy” rating. The company was upgraded on Monday, June 12 by Argus Research. The rating was upgraded by Barclays Capital to “Overweight”on Friday, December 8. The firm has “Outperform” rating by Macquarie Research given on Monday, October 19. The firm has “Neutral” rating by Bank of America given on Wednesday, January 25. The stock of Vodafone Group Plc (NASDAQ:VOD) has “Hold” rating given on Tuesday, September 20 by Argus Research. The stock has “Reduce” rating by Standpoint Research on Thursday, June 1. The rating was initiated by Standpoint Research with “Accumulate” on Tuesday, January 3. 
Merriman Wealth Management Llc, which manages about $1.58B and $420.67 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 18,675 shares to 31,013 shares, valued at $4.78 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Vanguard Index Fds (VOO) by 43,953 shares in the quarter, for a total of 75,329 shares, and has risen its stake in Select Sector Spdr Tr (XLY). 
Since September 25, 2017, it had 0 insider buys, and 6 sales for $6.90 million activity. $527,040 worth of stock was sold by Courduroux Pierre on Thursday, October 19. The insider Narain Duraiswami sold $343,200. MIZELL STEVEN sold 11,526 shares worth $1.38 million. Shares for $964,553 were sold by Ringenberg Nicole M. 
Among 23 analysts covering Monsanto Company ( NYSE:MON ), 12 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 52% are positive. Monsanto Company had 60 analyst reports since August 25, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Atlantic Securities downgraded the stock to “Neutral” rating in Friday, May 27 report. The rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets with “Hold” on Tuesday, September 5. The rating was maintained by Monness Crespi with “Buy” on Monday, October 3. The stock of Monsanto Company (NYSE:MON) earned “Overweight” rating by Piper Jaffray on Thursday, August 27. On Wednesday, September 30 the stock rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank with “Buy”. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Friday, July 1 by Citigroup. The stock of Monsanto Company (NYSE:MON) earned “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Thursday, August 27. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Friday, September 1 by BMO Capital Markets. On Friday, November 18 the stock rating was upgraded by OTR Global to “Mixed”. The stock has “Sell” rating by Goldman Sachs on Monday, April 11.
